note: Same architecture as run1 but FFN runs on separate thread while attention runs on main thread. Tests the parallel dispatch concept.
note_on_speedup: Minimal at 128-dim — FFN is only ~5ms, thread spawn overhead dominates. Real gain expected at 768-dim+ where ODE ~8ms ≈ attention ~10ms, and with GPU dispatch instead of thread spawn.
note_on_loss: Same loss values as run1 at matching iterations — parallel dispatch does not change outputs
